variation_axes.geology: independent SGSim realizations/seeds under a separately frozen geostatistical recipe
variation_axes.controls: well/control variants under separately frozen admissible ranges
variation_axes.physics: same source-authentic governing hierarchy unless a new versioned contract changes it

split_hierarchy.inner_case_split: streamline-group train/validation only inside development cases when required
split_hierarchy.case_level_development: multiple complete Foundation Cases available to model fitting
split_hierarchy.case_level_validation: entire unseen Foundation Cases for architecture/hyperparameter selection
split_hierarchy.case_level_test: entire unseen Foundation Cases touched only after selection
split_hierarchy.OOD_definition: unseen geology and/or unseen control Foundation Cases

leakage_prohibitions: no streamline from an OOD case may appear in training

no normalization statistics may be fit using OOD cases
no OOD test result may select architecture/loss weight/hyperparameters
case seeds and control assignments must be frozen before model training
foundation_model_claim_requirements: more than one training Foundation Case
